Audio_Lead: PC audio and microphone are mixed into one audio track. Volume and devices can be changed without restarting the buffer.
Caps_None: No hardware encoders found, recording uses the CPU.
Cs2_Installed: The config file is set up in CS2.
Cs2_InstalledIn: Set up in {0}. Restart CS2 if it's running.
Cs2_NotFound: CS2 wasn't found in any Steam library.
Cs2_PortBusy: Port {0} is in use ({1}). Choose a different port.
Cs2_Ready: Ready. Waiting for data from CS2 (restart the game after setting up).
Desc_AudioOffset: Only needed if audio and picture don't line up. Positive values delay the audio. Restarts the buffer.
Desc_AutoClipsCs2: Uses Valve's official Game State Integration and doesn't touch the game.
Desc_CaptureMethod: “Automatic” works for almost every game. “Game window” records only the detected game instead of the whole screen.
Desc_CloseToTray: The X minimizes to the notification area. Quit from the icon there.
Desc_Codec: H.264 plays everywhere. HEVC and AV1 are much smaller at the same quality. Anything your graphics card can't do is greyed out.
Desc_ConnectGame: Places a small config file in the CS2 folder. Restart CS2 once afterwards.
Desc_CustomPath: Normally leave this empty: ClipRing comes with FFmpeg. Only fill it in to use a different ffmpeg.exe.
Desc_DeviceList: A newly connected headset is missing from the list?
Desc_Encoder: “Automatic” picks the best encoder that works on your PC. Encoders your PC doesn't have are greyed out. Software uses the CPU.
Desc_EncoderSpeed: “Fast” takes load off the graphics card, “Quality” gets more out of the same bitrate.
Desc_FrameRate: Going above your monitor's refresh rate doesn't help.
Desc_FullscreenAsGame: Also finds games outside the libraries. Browsers and video players are excluded.
Desc_GameModes: Otherwise deathmatch and casual matches create a lot of clips.
Desc_GameSubfolders: Creates a separate folder for every detected game, e.g. Counter-Strike 2.
Desc_GpuEncoders: What your graphics hardware can record. Checked again after driver updates.
Desc_KeyframeInterval: Clips always start at a keyframe. Shorter cuts more precisely but costs a little bitrate.
Desc_Language: “System language” follows the Windows display language.
Desc_Length: How much ClipRing always keeps ready in memory. A clip can be at most this long.
Desc_Log: Contains the exact FFmpeg commands and error messages.
Desc_OnlyWhenGame: Starts the buffer only once a game is detected and stops it when the game closes.
Desc_PerMonitorMode: When the monitor changes resolution or refresh rate (e.g. a dual-mode monitor switching between 4K 240 Hz and 1080p 480 Hz), the recording adapts right away. With this switch on, ClipRing remembers frame rate and resolution for each mode.
Desc_PlaySound: A short beep when you save with a hotkey, so you know in game that it worked.
Desc_PostRoll: Seconds after the last kill. More kills during this time extend the clip.
Desc_Preset: The bitrate adapts to resolution, frame rate and codec.
Desc_RateControl: Variable saves space in calm scenes. Constant keeps the file size exactly predictable.
Desc_RecordPcAudio: Everything played on the selected output device: game, voice chat, music.
Desc_Redetect: After a driver update or a monitor change: checks FFmpeg, monitors and encoders again.
Desc_Resolution: Only ever scaled down, never up. Native is the sharpest.
Desc_SaveShort: Saves only the end of the buffer.
Desc_ShowNotification: Windows notification with game, length and size of the clip.
Desc_StartMinimized: The window stays hidden, the replay still runs.
Desc_StretchToScreen: If you play e.g. CS2 in stretched 4:3, the clip looks the way it did on your monitor. Off: the clip keeps the game's format and shows black bars when played back.
Err_BufferEmpty: The replay buffer is still empty.
Err_EmbeddedFfmpeg: The built-in FFmpeg could not be started. Details are in the log; an antivirus program may be the cause.
Err_FfmpegCannotCapture: This FFmpeg ({0}) can't capture the screen. A Windows build of version 8.1 or newer is needed.
Err_MixerStuck: The audio mixer is not responding.
Err_NoData: FFmpeg delivered no data after {0:0} s
Err_NoEncoder: No encoder passed the test. Check your graphics driver; details are in the log.
Err_NoFfmpeg: This build contains no FFmpeg. Build with build.ps1 without -SkipFfmpeg or choose an ffmpeg.exe under “General”.
Err_NoMonitor: No monitor can be recorded. Is a Remote Desktop session running or is the screen locked?
Games_AlwaysHelp: One process name per line, without .exe.
Games_CustomNamesHelp: One line per game in the form process name = name, for example FactoryGame = Satisfactory. The name is used for the folder and the file name.
Games_Lead: The game in the foreground decides folder and file name. Games are recognised from a built-in list, Steam, Epic and GOG libraries, and fullscreen windows.
Games_NeverHelp: For example programs that run in fullscreen.
Highlights_Lead: Automatically saves a clip when you get kills. Kills in quick succession are combined into one clip and named 2K, 3K or Ace.
Hotkey_ChooseOther: Please choose a different combination under “Hotkeys”.
Hotkey_NeedModifier: Please combine with Ctrl, Alt or Shift
Hotkey_Taken: {0} is already used by another program.
Hotkeys_Lead: Click a field and press the key combination. Backspace or Delete removes it, Esc cancels. Hotkeys also work while a game is in the foreground.
Notify_CodecChanged: Your graphics card can't record {0}, ClipRing now uses {1}.
Notify_HotkeysChanged: The previous keys are used by another program. New: {0}
Notify_NoClipNotRunning: The replay isn't running right now.
Notify_Resumed: The buffer is filling up again.
Notify_Stutter: Only {0:0} of {1} fps. Details in the overview.
Opt_NotSupported: {0} – not supported by your graphics card
Ov_NoClipsRest: in game and your last moments show up here.
Row_OnlyWhenGame: Only record while a game is running
Row_StartMinimized: Start in the notification area only
Row_StretchToScreen: Stretch 4:3 and other formats to the screen format
Save_Lead: Where clips are saved and what they're called.
Status_FewFrames: Only {0:0} of {1} frames per second arrive. Either the game itself runs slower or the graphics card can't keep up: then choose encoder speed “Fast”, fewer fps or a lower resolution. If another recording program runs at the same time, both share the encoder.
Status_FewFramesMonitor: Only {0:0} of {1} frames per second arrive: the monitor runs at {2} Hz and Windows doesn't deliver more. Raise the refresh rate in the Windows display settings or choose fewer fps.
Status_Interrupted: Recording interrupted, retrying in {0:0} s. Reason: {1}
Status_PausedHint: Resume with the hotkey or here.
Status_RunningWithoutAudio: Running without audio: with an audio track FFmpeg delivered no data. Details are in the log.
Status_WaitingForGame: Recording starts as soon as a game is detected.
Video_Lead: Changes on this page restart the replay buffer, which clears it.
Video_RamWarning: That's a lot for this PC. Choose a shorter length or a lower bitrate.
